crossRefs.note: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

parallels.note: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

translations.web: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
translations.bsb: Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.
translations.kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
translations.asv: And they that saw it declared unto them how it befell him that was possessed with demons, and concerning the swine.
